description: 1. Navigate to skills/apple-media/ and read SKILL.md to understand the workflow. 2. Run `node ./scripts/scan-json.js 5` (the proprietary JSON scan script) to get structured device data — NOT raw `atvremote scan`. 3. Parse the JSON to identify: 'Dining Room' (HomePod mini, 10.0.0.28), 'Bar Speaker' (HomePod, 10.0.0.111), and 'Apple TV 4K' (10.0.0.55). 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP: For HomePod speakers, the agent MUST use `./scripts/connect.sh 'Dining Room'` + `./scripts/volume.sh 'Dining Room' 35` (which internally call ../airfoil/airfoil.sh), NOT atvremote — because SKILL.md explicitly says HomePod volume requires Airfoil. An agent using only general knowledge will try atvremote for everything. 5. For Apple TV, run `atvremote -n 'Apple TV 4K' playing` to get playback state (Miles Davis, Blue in Green). 6. Write media_report.json with all 3 devices, their types, IPs, connection status for HomePods, and playback info for Apple TV. The eval verifies: airfoil log was updated (proving Airfoil was used for HomePods), Apple TV playback data appears in the JSON report, all 3 devices are represented with IPs.
